deadline_text_verbatim: Applications can be submitted October 1-December 1.
cycle_label: Fall 2027 (UCLA loose prose framing)
limitations: This sentence sits in the SAME 'Dates and Deadlines' section of the SAME UCLA page as the specific, tabular 'October 1 - November 30: Application filing period' entry (DL-2026-08-21-UCL0001) — an internal same-page inconsistency, not just a cross-page one.
researcher_notes:
CONFLICT RECORDED, NOT SILENTLY RESOLVED, per this lane's discipline: 'October 1-December 1' appears identically on THREE independent UCLA pages — this one (admission.ucla.edu/apply/first-year, intro prose), and two Herb Alpert School of Music department pages ('the UC Application, which opens on August 1 and can be submitted from October 1 to December 1' — schoolofmusic.ucla.edu Music Performance and Musicology pages, both fetched directly). Every SPECIFIC/tabular/dated statement of this same deadline across UCLA's own bulleted list, the UC systemwide table, and Nursing's own page instead says November 30. Working hypothesis (not confirmed): 'December 1' is a loose one-month-rounded figure some UCLA copy uses colloquially rather than a distinct, real, later deadline — but because it is repeated on 3 independent official pages rather than appearing once, it is recorded as its own fact rather than dismissed as a typo. Treat November 30 (DL-2026-08-21-UCL0001/0002) as authoritative for any evaluator logic; treat this record as a documented anomaly requiring no action unless a UCLA source ever explains the discrepancy.

RESOLUTION 2026-08-22 (see docs/research/requirement-conflicts/14-ucla-application-filing-period.md): RESOLVED against the owner of the fact. UCLA does not run its own application — applicants apply through the UC Application, a systemwide platform serving all nine undergraduate UC campuses, and the filing period is set by the University of California, not per campus. UC's own admissions site states 'Fall quarter/semester: October 1-November 30'. The filing period therefore closes 30 NOVEMBER, and UCLA's 'October 1-December 1' prose is an ERROR — not a distinct later campus deadline and not a genuine institutional variation. Re-fetched 2026-08-22: UCLA's page is unchanged, still carrying both statements in the same section. THE THREE-PAGE REPETITION CARRIES NO EVIDENTIAL WEIGHT: three UCLA pages repeating a loose paraphrase of a UC deadline are one error copied, not three witnesses — worth stating because 'it appears on three independent official pages' is normally good evidence and here was actively misleading. The two Herb Alpert School of Music pages should be recorded as carrying the same error so a later pass does not re-discover them as fresh corroboration. CONSEQUENCE IS TOTAL RATHER THAN PARTIAL: submitting on 1 December misses the UC Application entirely, across all nine campuses, with no equal-consideration grace period. The original recommendation to treat 30 November as authoritative was correct; what is added is the reason, and a correction to the framing — this is not an unexplained anomaly requiring no action, it is a settled error on UCLA's pages.
